Project Lifecycle

BackLot Project Timeline

From first conversation to first rent check — 9 to 11 months, fully managed. One $30K flat fee covers every phase.

🔍
Property Assessment & Feasibility
BackLot reviews the lot, zoning, setbacks, and equity position. We deliver a full ADU financial model — rental income, value added, payback period. No cost, no commitment.
Wk 1–2Free
💰
Equity Strategy & Financing
We structure the self-funding plan using existing home equity. HELOC or cash-out refi — we model both, compare rates, and connect the homeowner with our vetted lending partners. Zero out-of-pocket.
Wk 3–4$0 Upfront
📐
Design & Engineering
Our architect produces full construction documents. We handle structural engineering, Title 24 energy compliance, and CalGreen — all included in the flat management fee. Homeowner reviews and approves the final design.
Wk 5–8Included
📋
Permitting
BackLot submits all applications to LADBS and tracks status weekly. We front-run common correction requests and escalate where possible. LA's ADU streamlined review typically runs 6–10 weeks.
Wk 9–18Fully Managed
🏗️
Construction Management
BackLot oversees our vetted GC network through foundation, framing, MEP, drywall, finishes, and landscaping restoration. Weekly site visits, change order review, and quality sign-off at every phase gate.
Wk 19–36Full Oversight
✅
Certificate of Occupancy
Final city inspection, utility connections, and CO issuance. Unit is legally habitable, smoke/CO detectors installed, and address assigned. Ready to list.
Wk 37Done
🎉
Tenant Placement & First Rent
BackLot helps list the unit, screen applicants, execute the lease, and collect the first month. Rental income starts. BackLot's engagement is complete — the homeowner keeps 100% of all future income.
Wk 38–40$2,500–$4,000/mo

Operations Toolkit

BackLot Playbooks & Checklists

Every process BackLot runs, documented. Use these to onboard team members, vet partners, and execute deals consistently at scale.

📊Deal Underwriting ChecklistCopy ↗

Run every inbound lead through this before any site visit or proposal. Go/no-go in under 5 minutes.

✓ Lot size ≥ 6,000 sqft & backyard ≥ 2,000 sqft
✓ Zoning: R1, R2, RD, RS, or RA (LA County)
✓ Home equity ≥ $300K (homeValue − mortgage)
✓ Household income ≤ $100K/yr (income-motivated)
✓ Years owned ≥ 10 (low likelihood of sale near-term)
✓ Home value ≥ $450K (ADU ROI is accretive)
✓ No active liens, probate, or trust disputes on title
✓ Homeowner is primary occupant (not absentee)
UnderwritingLead QualGo/No-Go
📋LADBS Permit Filing ChecklistCopy ↗

Step-by-step submission checklist for LA Department of Building & Safety. Minimizes correction cycles.

✓ Site plan: setbacks, lot coverage, existing structures
✓ Floor plan & elevations (fully dimensioned)
✓ Title 24 Part 6 energy calculations
✓ CalGreen Tier 1 compliance checklist
✓ Structural calculations (if new construction)
✓ Soils report (if hillside or expansive soil area)
✓ Electrical load calculations & panel schedule
✓ Utility will-serve letters (LADWP, SoCalGas)
✓ Owner declaration (owner-occupied affidavit for ADU)
LADBSPermitsLA City
🔨Contractor Vetting ChecklistCopy ↗

25-point GC qualification framework. Run every contractor before adding them to the BackLot network.

✓ CSLB license active & in good standing (check cslb.ca.gov)
✓ General liability: min $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate
✓ Workers' comp current (certificate + endorsement)
✓ 3 recent ADU references — verified by BackLot
✓ Bid includes itemized CSI-format scope of work
✓ Draw schedule: milestone-based, not time-based
✓ Lien waiver protocol agreed in writing
✓ Completed ≥ 5 ADU projects in LA County
GC VettingInsuranceCSLB
🏦Equity Financing Decision FrameworkCopy ↗

Help homeowners choose the right financing vehicle. Run before lender referrals to set expectations.

HELOC — best if: equity > 40%, existing low-rate 1st mortgage
Cash-out refi — best if: current rate is already > 6.5%
ADU construction loan — best if: low equity, strong income
✓ Confirm DTI ≤ 43% post-draw (lender qualifying threshold)
✓ Pull 3-bureau credit — min 680 for standard HELOC
✓ Order appraisal or AVM before submitting to lenders
✓ Model break-even: rent income vs. monthly debt service
✓ Confirm draw schedule aligns with construction milestones
HELOCFinancingLender
🔑CO & Lease-Up ChecklistCopy ↗

Final phase: Certificate of Occupancy through first rent check. Completes BackLot's scope.

✓ Schedule final inspection with LADBS (allow 5–10 days)
✓ Smoke & CO detectors installed per CA R315
✓ Address posted & clearly visible from street
✓ Utility meters separate from main house
✓ List on Zillow, Apartments.com, Craigslist simultaneously
✓ Screen: credit, income (3× rent), rental history
✓ Execute CA residential lease (1-year initial term)
✓ Collect security deposit ≤ 2 months rent (CA law)
✓ Hand over keys. Collect first rent. Engagement complete.
COLease-UpTenant
🏠Homeowner Onboarding ScriptCopy ↗

First-call framework. Qualify, educate, and set expectations in a 20-minute conversation.

1. Confirm property ownership & primary occupancy
2. Ask: "Are you open to passive income from your backyard?"
3. Confirm equity position (rough — don't ask for Zillow)
4. Explain BackLot model: $30K fee, $0 out-of-pocket
5. Quote rent range for their neighborhood
6. Confirm timeline: 9–11 months first call to first rent
7. Address objections: "we handle everything"
8. Schedule site visit within 48 hours
SalesOnboardingScript
How to use: Click any checklist to copy it as plain text. Paste into Notion, Google Docs, or email. All checklists reflect current LADBS requirements and CA ADU law as of 2025.
